_note: Run configuration for the Honest Containment suite. Copy to agents.json and fill in every value written placeholder. No key is ever written in this file: each system names the environment variable its key is read from. A value still reading placeholder makes preflight fail, and the results row reads not run with that reason.
price_list_date: placeholder - the date the provider price lists were read, charter 5.5
model_versions_in_scope: placeholder - the model version strings a person decided to score
spend_cap_note: placeholder - a spend cap must be set with each provider before a run

customer_model.base_url: placeholder - the provider API base, ending in /v1

judge_model.model: placeholder - model version string, must differ from every model under test

voice-platform-a.base_url: placeholder - the platform API base, from its current documentation
voice-platform-a.docs_date: placeholder - the date of the API documentation used

voice-platform-b.base_url: placeholder - the platform API base, from its current documentation
voice-platform-b.docs_date: placeholder - the date of the API documentation used

general-llm.display_name: general model with the reference agent prompt

model.base_url: placeholder - the provider API base, ending in /v1
placeholder - the provider API base, ending in /v1
